concepts.name: 并行双向
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: desktop app icon exploration for Bandix, a network bandwidth and live traffic monitor.
Primary request: a distinctive, beautiful BIDIRECTIONAL NETWORK TRAFFIC symbol, emphasizing upload and download equally. No letters, no B, no text.
Exactly ONE centered icon on a square canvas. A deep midnight navy opaque rounded-square tile occupies 86% of the canvas, with true transparent empty outer margin. A compact balanced emblem with generous internal margins. Bright cyan/turquoise represents download and warm orange represents upload. Bold geometric strokes, clean negative space, clear arrow direction at small 24–32 px sizes. Refined mostly-flat branding with only very subtle tonal shading. Clean smooth alpha edges, solid untextured tile.
Avoid: mockups, sheets, multiple icons, captions, watermark, thin lines, tiny circuitry, glows, external shadows, excessive 3D, particles or stray pixels.
Subject: two equally weighted thick vertical arrows side by side, an orange upward arrow on the left and a cyan downward arrow on the right. The inner edges of their stems bow gently toward each other at the midpoint, suggesting paired network lanes, with a narrow clean dark gap between them. Arrowheads are broad but elegantly proportioned with softly rounded corners. Orange arrow starts lower; cyan arrow starts higher; both together form a compact upright rounded-rectangular silhouette. Extremely simple memorable balanced app mark, no circular paths or connecting lines.
